integrity: The known difference-set constructions, Fourier overlap levels and Weyl diagonalization are credited; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Optimization is restricted to at most k nonzero coordinates and group order k(k-1)+1.
Near-SIC comparison concerns the least ambiguity intensity, not overall equiangularity.
Full manuscripts of two directly motivating 2026 preprints were unavailable; comparison uses verified abstracts and older primary full-text results.
Finite examples support, but do not replace, the general proof.
title: Sparse-optimal Gabor tomography on Singer cycles: complete rigidity and near-SIC floor
